description.value:
A burst of temporal energy ripples outward from you, seizing the threads of fate around each target and forcing a re-evaluation of their place in the combat order. For each target, the effect depends on whether they are your ally or your enemy:

Ally: The target may immediately reroll their initiative, taking the higher of the new roll or their current initiative value (this is a fortune effect). This takes effect at the start of the next round.

Enemy: The target must attempt a Will save. On a failure, you force them to reroll their initiative, and you choose which of the two results applies (this is a misfortune effect). On a success, the target is unaffected. New initiative results take effect at the start of the next round.

A creature can only be affected by Reset once per encounter.

Critical Success The enemy is unaffected and temporarily immune to Reset for 24 hours.

Success The enemy is unaffected.

Failure You choose which of the two rolled initiative values applies to the enemy.

Critical Failure As failure, and the enemy also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard]{Off-Guard} to all creatures until the end of its next turn as temporal disorientation washes over it.

Heightened (+1) The number of targets increases by 1.
